title: Best AI Mobile App Builder for Ecommerce and Shopping Apps in 2026
summary: We scored seven AI mobile app builders on the eight things that matter to a native shopping app: catalog and checkout, payment rules, push for orders and carts, store sync, and accounts that remember every customer.
body_markdown:
Blink, at 72 out of 80, because it builds the catalog, orders, Stripe checkout, push, and an in-app AI assistant on one database. Adalo is second at 54 and leads on Shopify sync.


No. Apple's guideline 3.1.3(e) says physical goods and services consumed outside the app must use methods such as Apple Pay or card entry rather than in-app purchase.


Start with the website if you have none, and add the app for push, saved accounts, and repeat buyers. Our ranking of AI website builders for ecommerce covers the web side.


Adalo lists a Shopify-to-app path. Blink connects 63 tools and databases and can reach Shopify through connectors, and FlutterFlow imports OpenAPI definitions.


Yes. Blink apps can call 74 text models plus image models, so a product finder or visual search runs without API keys.
